rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial homogenization procedure with several interacting components (Eshelby tensor, Mori-Tanaka, double-inclusion, quadratic interpolation, orientation averaging). Translating the equations into correct tensor code and performing the orientation integrals requires a solid grasp of the domain, but the paper gives the complete mathematical recipe, obviating the need for new derivation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a single Python script that executes the homogenization, writes the stiffness matrix JSON, and then derives and saves the isotropic constants. No dependency management beyond numpy/scipy, no external data, and no multi-stage orchestration. The sequential steps are simple I/O handoffs.
